card.name: Spots just before a dose number
card.fires_on: The spot right before a dose or amount number appears, such as a space or opening bracket after a unit or "rate of". It also fires inside numbers like 100 or 1,000,000.

modes.label: Before bracketed or rate value
modes.description: Space or bracket right after a unit or "rate of", where the next value follows.

modes.label: Inside a number range
modes.description: Digits or "to" within a list or range of dose amounts.
modes.example: in increments of 0.1<< to>> 0.2 mg/kg every

card.writes: It lowers large-number words like thousands and million, and slightly raises "having" or "have" words.
card.plain: It marks the point just before a dose amount or range is written out in numbers.
